# 21 CFR Part 11 — electronic records and electronic signatures (US FDA): clause → mechanism → status

This table maps clauses to SecuraCV mechanisms. It is not a determination: the regulated organization, and the FDA on inspection decides whether a deployment's records and controls are acceptable. The receipt ledgers are the record; this table points at them. Status words: [STATUS.md](STATUS.md). The frame: [README.md](README.md).

Source: 21 CFR Part 11 — not fetched (blocked); requirement text is our paraphrase and every clause marked † is unverified: ecfr.gov, govinfo.gov and law.cornell.edu were unreachable when this map was written; clause numbers follow common citation and are unverified; requirement text is our paraphrase
